alerts.name: SQL Injection - Boolean Based Blind
alerts.desc: Boolean-based blind SQL injection was detected in the product catalogue endpoint. The database executes injected boolean statements allowing data exfiltration.

instances.evidence: Item retrieved successfully on TRUE condition

alerts.solution: Utilize parameterized queries / prepared statements with PDO or SQLAlchemy ORM instead of dynamic string concatenation.

alerts.name: Cross-Site Scripting (Reflected)
alerts.desc: User-supplied query parameter 'search_term' is reflected in the server HTML response without contextual sanitization or output escaping.
alerts.solution: Implement contextual HTML entity encoding and adopt a strict Content Security Policy (CSP) header.

alerts.alert: Content Security Policy (CSP) Header Not Set
alerts.name: Content Security Policy (CSP) Header Not Set
alerts.desc: Content Security Policy (CSP) is an added layer of security that helps to detect and mitigate certain types of attacks, including Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) and data injection attacks.
alerts.solution: Ensure that your web server, application server, or load balancer sets a Content-Security-Policy response header.

alerts.name: Cookie No HttpOnly Flag
alerts.desc: A cookie has been set without the HttpOnly flag, which permits JavaScript to read sensitive session tokens.
alerts.solution: Set the HttpOnly flag on all sensitive authentication and session cookies.

alerts.name: Strict-Transport-Security Header Not Set
alerts.desc: The HTTP Strict-Transport-Security header is not enforced, allowing potential SSL stripping downgrade attacks.
alerts.solution: Configure the server to send Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains header.
